meaning: 'verified' means an independent reader attested every item against the source. It does not upgrade any compliance claim, and the script cannot prove the reader's independence - it records the attestation.

verifier.statement: I opened the source PDF directly and dumped its per-character font runs with pdfplumber for all seven pages, grouping every glyph by fontname and size, and also dumped page geometry (drawn rules, rects, image bounding boxes and glyph colours) to check heading underlines, the page-5 redaction block and the e-mail styling. I then read the rebuilt HTML in full and compared every emphasis run in both directions - source to rebuild for anything missed, rebuild to source for anything over-styled - checking span boundaries character by character at every quotation mark, comma, conjunction and terminal period. I extracted and viewed the embedded logo image, and ran a token-level completeness and no-invention comparison across all seven pages.
